text: おれの　いえを　こんなに　しちまいやがって！

structure.jp: こんなに　しちまいやがって！
structure.en: they went and made it like this!

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちまう is a rough, shortened てしまう, which says the thing was done completely and you are unhappy about it. しちまい = 'went and did'.

patterns.name: 〜やがる
patterns.explanation: やがる added to a verb shows anger and contempt at the person who did it. しちまいやがって = 'those jerks went and did it!'

patterns.name: 〜にする
patterns.span: こんなに　しちまいやがって
patterns.explanation: に plus する means to make something end up in that state. こんなに　しちまいやがって = 'they went and made it like this'.
